scope: Final-catalog follow-up for the 19 missing warfare creature details, 9 missing HeroClassHOMM7 details, and 110 missing HeroHOMM7 rows.
policy: No game installation was downloaded, no live database was changed, and no existing non-null fact was overwritten. Only additions and fills are mergeable; candidateChanges and evidenceOnly are review metadata, not import rows.

supports: The Heroes tab is configured per map and per player.
The manual screenshot shows the 22 existing base-game rows already recorded as true in HeroHOMM7.
The manual does not establish global false values for the other 110 heroes.
Heroes VII creature content is data-driven through H7Creature archetypes.
The authoritative values are in game/editor package data and include stats and visuals; this checkout contains no such package.

sources.publisherAttribution: The mirror reproduces Ubisoft's former MMH7 Shadow Council posts; rssing.com itself is not Ubisoft and is not treated as a primary host.
supports: The mirrored Ubisoft-authored Fortress Warfare Units article identifies Runestone, Fire Cannon and Dwarven Ballista.
The mirrored Ubisoft-authored Fortress Heroes article identifies Warlord, Jarl, Thane, Firebrander, Runelord and Engraver and describes their roles/main skills.
The mirrored Ubisoft-authored patch notes record patch-level balancing and bug fixes, so numeric data must be tied to a final package/patch revision.

sources.publisherAttribution: This is a third-party mirror of Ubisoft's former MMH7 Shadow Council; the direct Ubisoft host is no longer available to this tool.
supports: The mirrored Ubisoft Skillwheel design article says a hero class is defined by a fixed skillwheel and that faction/class relationships are part of the game design.
The mirrored Ubisoft-authored Dungeon article explicitly identifies Lyla as Archon; this corroborates the existing Lyla-to-Archon generic Hero.HeroClass_id link.
Independent published baseline stats for Haven Healing Sister, Haven Ballista and Catapult.
The page reports movement 0 for these warfare units, but the current schema has no Stationary movement value and this does not establish combat square size.
Independent roster confirmation for the three Fortress warfare units and their roles.
A dated pre-Trial-by-Fire class table gives candidate Archon and Embalmer growth percentages.
Those candidates were not applied because the catalog's existing research records a class-label conflict and no final package-level verification is available.
The roster of all 19 missing warfare identities and their faction placement.
Individual linked unit pages publish rank-varying attack, defense, health, damage or support values for most of the 19 units.
These values are retained only as cross-check evidence until the official H7 archetype packages are available.

candidateChanges.reason: All 19 warfare records expose rank 1-5 vectors. A single CreatureHOMM7 scalar row would discard data or silently choose an arbitrary rank. Support units also expose healing/protection values rather than ordinary damage. Keep the rank facts normalized and preserve the effect kind.
minimumColumns: Creature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES CreatureHOMM7(Creature_id)
Rank SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (Rank BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
candidateChanges.candidateRepresentation: If the package-backed import confirms stationary warfare units and unknown footprint, do not map printed movement 0 to Ground, Flying or Teleporting and do not map textual Large to an arbitrary square count. One possible extension is Stationary plus nullable/explicitly unknown CombatSize, or nullable warfare fields guarded by a Warfare-specific CHECK.

candidateChanges.reason: Ubisoft's Editor Manual makes per-map/per-player enablement an override. Existing HeroHOMM7.IsHallHero can remain catalog-level eligibility/default metadata; a map/player junction is optional if the project later captures map-specific overrides. The 110 unknown rows must not be forced to false.
minimumColumns: Map_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES Map(Map_id)
Hero_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES Hero(Hero_id)
PlayerNumber SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (PlayerNumber BETWEEN 1 AND 8)
candidateChanges.migrationNote: The current HeroHOMM7.IsHallHero is NOT NULL. Relax it only if unknown catalog-level eligibility must be represented; otherwise leave the existing 22 documented values intact and add map/player overrides separately. Never backfill unknown heroes as false.

candidateChanges.reason: Nine generic class identities exist but the required original-game growth fields are not safely resolved. The dated 2015 secondary table supplies candidates for Archon and Embalmer but conflicts with other secondary values; Fortress classes and Hell Knight require final game/editor package verification.

The official editor proves that map/player enablement can override the catalog. The 22 rows in the documented manual screenshot have positive catalog evidence; the remaining 110 rows have no safe catalog-level eligibility evidence in this checkout and remain absent rather than being assigned false.

The generic Hero rows already point to the unresolved class identities. Existing generic HeroClass descriptions carry the faction/focus labels; the class-detail sidecars cannot be completed until growth values are verified. Ubisoft-authored Fortress material mirrored by rssing.com supplies main-skill descriptions, but the current schema has no MainSkills or ClassMechanics column.

The following vectors are useful for the next package-backed import, but are not direct additions because current CreatureHOMM7 has no rank child table and does not represent support effects, Stationary movement or unknown square footprint.

homm7.creature.runestone.effectSemantics: Rune heal is percentage-based in the published ability text; the secondary page's damage-like vector is not imported as damage.

blockedFacts: No complete source-backed CreatureHOMM7 row can be emitted while Attack/Defense/Damage/Health are rank vectors and Speed, Movement and CombatSize are not authoritative in the available sources.
No HeroClassHOMM7 row can be emitted from a conflicting secondary table; all required growth fields must be supplied together once final package data is available.
No HeroHOMM7 false flags can be emitted for the 110 unverified heroes because catalog eligibility is not established for them and map/player enablement is a separate override.
The correct final source is the installed final H7 editor/game package, not a full-game download by this research task.
